test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: From which of the following countries has the Freedom of Trade feature been taken by the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The freedom of trade, commerce, and exchange within the nation is discussed in **Article 301**.
 
• It provides that the ability to engage in these activities shall be unrestricted, subject to additional requirements under **Part XIII**.
 
• The **Australian constitution** is where **India** borrowed the idea of free trade for its own constitution.
 
• The constitution's Article 19 G grants the right to engage in any employment, trade, or business.
 
• According to Section 92 of the Australian Constitution, there should be freedom of trade, commerce, and intercourse that can be conducted through internal or ocean transportation.
 
• The Australian Constitution's Section 92 states that there should be freedom of trade, commerce, and intercourse that can be conducted via internal or ocean transportation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The things borrowed by other countries are given as follows:
 
 
• **USSR:**

 
 
• Fundamental duties 
 
• Ideals of justice
 
 
 
• **Germany:**
 
 
• The Union will have emergency powers
 
• Fundamental rights will be suspended in an emergency.
 
 
 
• **Ireland:**
 
 
• Directive Elements of Government Policy 
 
• Nomination of Rajya Sabha members 
 
• Method of President Election
